articles.headline: José Mourinho complains Real Madrid have 24 hours less rest than Barcelona ahead of El Clásico
articles.description: Real Madrid coach José Mourinho was keen to point out after his side's win over Leipzig that his team will have 24 hours less rest than Sunday's rivals Barcelona heading into the Clásico.

articles.headline: José Mourinho, Kylian Mbappé defend Vinícius Júnior after whistles from Real Madrid fans

articles.headline: Mourinho made Real Madrid-Barcelona Clásico rivalry unmissable. Now, he's back for more

articles.description: Kylian Mbappé has warned that "not much" should be read into Madrid's dismantling of RB Leipzig ahead of Sunday's Clásico, but Jose Mourinho is surely starting to figure out who his best XI is.
